entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; guard my life from fear of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: Hide me from the council of those who injure, from the rebelling of the workers of iniquity,

entries.title: Psalms 64:3
segments: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, they tread their arrows, [even] a bitter word,

entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: so that they may shoot at the blameless one from a lurking place; suddenly they shoot at him, and fear not.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: They encourage themselves [in] an evil plan; they talk of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They search out injustice, [saying], We have finished hiding a hidden plot. Yea, the inward part of man and [the] heart [are] deep.

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly they shall be wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: So they shall be confounded; their tongue [falls] on themselves; everyone seeing them shall flee.

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall in wisdom think of His doing.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
